result.keywords: This article presents a fictional framework for mapping submerged archival markers using autonomous buoy arrays, low-light spectral tagging, and tide-synchronized route planning. The proposed method targets intertidal heritage zones rather than robotic control, bacterial imaging, or expressive interfaces, and it emphasizes preservation logistics, maritime sensing, and cartographic annotation. Simulated field trials compare daytime and nocturnal detection rates across variable salinity conditions.
result.title: Drift Lanterns for Tidal Archive Mapping.
